cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks for the lift. I'll sort our shifts: I take your Saturday, and you're more than repaid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I take the whole weekend. You can choose what you do with it; I want this properly balanced.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to take you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move my flight. You take a full week off and I'll cover it. Pick the week before I change the booking; I'll fit my plans around yours and get us properly ahead on my side.
